say:1:1710603001:1.text: I overheard him speaking with Prince Orion just now...
say:1:1710603001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，我刚刚听到了父亲和奥利安王子的对话……
say:1:1710603001:1.male: I overheard him speaking with Prince Orion just now...
say:1:1710603001:1.female: I overheard him speaking with Prince Orion just now...

say:4:1710603003:1.text: I told him what we found in Silken Snare's kitchen, and that Madam Voracia might be connected to the disappearance of the Hall of Ancients.
say:4:1710603003:1.source_cn: 我向父亲汇报了我们在丝绒陷阱后厨的发现，以及法蒂玛女士...

say:4:1710603003:1.female: I told him what we found in Silken Snare's kitchen, and that Madam Voracia might be connected to the disappearance of the Hall of Ancients.

say:5:1710603004:1.text: But he refused to send the guard to raid the place. He said we were out of line for trespassing, and that we can't make accusations without proof...
say:5:1710603004:1.source_cn: 但父亲不同意调动守备军查封丝绒陷阱，还斥责我们擅自闯入...
say:5:1710603004:1.male: But he refused to send the guard to raid the place. He said we were out of line for trespassing, and that we can't make accusations without proof...
say:5:1710603004:1.female: But he refused to send the guard to raid the place. He said we were out of line for trespassing, and that we can't make accusations without proof...

say:6:1710603005:1.text: Then he said he had urgent business and rushed out. It felt off, so I followed him. And... I heard him reporting everything to Prince Orion.
say:6:1710603005:1.source_cn: 之后父亲说有公务在身，匆忙出门了。我觉得父亲的态度太反...
say:6:1710603005:1.male: Then he said he had urgent business and rushed out. It felt off, so I followed him. And... I heard him reporting everything to Prince Orion.
say:6:1710603005:1.female: Then he said he had urgent business and rushed out. It felt off, so I followed him. And... I heard him reporting everything to Prince Orion.

choice_prompt:7:1710603005.text: Then he said he had urgent business and rushed out. It felt off, so I followed him. And... I heard him reporting everything to Prince Orion.
choice_prompt:7:1710603005.source_cn: 之后父亲说有公务在身，匆忙出门了。我觉得父亲的态度太反常了，就悄悄跟了上去。结果……我听到他正在向奥利安王子汇报这件事。

choice_prompt:7:1710603005.female: Then he said he had urgent business and rushed out. It felt off, so I followed him. And... I heard him reporting everything to Prince Orion.

say:8:1710603006:1.text: At first, he sounded indifferent. Father even brought up Magister Cyran and the Hastings family, and the Prince barely reacted.
say:8:1710603006:1.source_cn: 刚开始，王子殿下听起来还很漫不经心。父亲还提到了迪尔格...

say:8:1710603006:1.female: At first, he sounded indifferent. Father even brought up Magister Cyran and the Hastings family, and the Prince barely reacted.

say:9:1710603007:1.text: But the moment Father mentioned Voracia and Silken Snare, Prince Orion sounded... insulted. Angry, even.
say:9:1710603007:1.source_cn: 但当父亲提到“法蒂玛”和“丝绒陷阱”这两个名字时，王子...
say:9:1710603007:1.male: But the moment Father mentioned Voracia and Silken Snare, Prince Orion sounded... insulted. Angry, even.
say:9:1710603007:1.female: But the moment Father mentioned Voracia and Silken Snare, Prince Orion sounded... insulted. Angry, even.

say:10:1710603008:1.text: Then, suddenly, the Prince ordered Father not to be at the hunting grounds today.
say:10:1710603008:1.source_cn: 紧接着，王子突然下令，让父亲不必参加今日狮心猎场的行猎了。

say:12:1710603009:1.text: I don't believe my father would ever conspire against the Crown!
say:12:1710603009:1.source_cn: 我不相信父亲会参加任何针对王室的阴谋！
say:12:1710603009:1.male: I don't believe my father would ever conspire against the Crown!
say:12:1710603009:1.female: I don't believe my father would ever conspire against the Crown!

say:13:1710603010:1.text: He's a loyal man. An honorable one. But the Prince...
say:13:1710603010:1.source_cn: 父亲是个忠诚且正直的人！但王子……
say:13:1710603010:1.male: He's a loyal man. An honorable one. But the Prince...
say:13:1710603010:1.female: He's a loyal man. An honorable one. But the Prince...

say:14:1710603011:1.text: ... To say it aloud feels treasonous, but... could Prince Orion be behind Peggy's disappearance? And that of the Hall of Ancients?
say:14:1710603011:1.source_cn: ……这话说出来有些僭越，但奥利安王子，难道是他在幕后策...
say:14:1710603011:1.male: ... To say it aloud feels treasonous, but... could Prince Orion be behind Peggy's disappearance? And that of the Hall of Ancients?
say:14:1710603011:1.female: ... To say it aloud feels treasonous, but... could Prince Orion be behind Peggy's disappearance? And that of the Hall of Ancients?

say:15:1710603012:1.text: But he's the eldest. The people love him, and he's the rightful heir. Why would he do something like this?
say:15:1710603012:1.source_cn: 可奥利安王子既是长子，又深得民心，本就是理所当然的继承...
say:15:1710603012:1.male: But he's the eldest. The people love him, and he's the rightful heir. Why would he do something like this?
say:15:1710603012:1.female: But he's the eldest. The people love him, and he's the rightful heir. Why would he do something like this?

say:16:1710603013:1.text: And if he hurt Peggy... he'd never be deemed worthy in the Excalibur rite.
